encode_gif_from_images: encode a list of numpy image arrays into a GIF animation using ffmpeg at a given fps
build_gif_encoder: build a python module that encodes numpy image arrays into GIF format using ffmpeg subprocess
test_encode_gif: test the encode_gif function by passing a list of numpy arrays and verifying GIF output
refactor_encode_gif: refactor the encode_gif function to support additional pixel formats beyond gray, rgb24, and rgba
review_encode_gif: review the encode_gif function and its use of ffmpeg palettegen and paletteuse filters for quality
